math_specs.description: Set LIMIT-AMT to 500000 when RISK-CD is between 1 and 3 inclusive.
Set LIMIT-AMT to 50000 when RISK-CD is not between 1 and 3 inclusive and is either 5 or between 7 and 9 inclusive.
math_specs.expression: ((NOT (RISK-CD-OLD >= 1 AND RISK-CD-OLD <= 3)) AND ((RISK-CD-OLD = 5) OR (RISK-CD-OLD >= 7 AND RISK-CD-OLD <= 9)) IMPLIES (LIMIT-AMT-NEW = 50000))
